title: Ioel
summary: Raleigh names Ioel in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Ioel, sonne of Samuel, who iudged the people with Abijah at Beersheba; not the Iudaean prophet whom Glycas calls Ioel. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.

free_source_links.locator: Book II, Part I, Chapter XVI, §. I, sig. 285b–286a
